sections.title: Instructional examples

steps: Both are supplementary to the same angle.
Angles supplementary to the same angle are equal.
workedSolution.answer: both supplementary to a common angle

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. One angle measures 135°. Find the measure of the alternate interior angle.
In a triangle, the two remote interior angles measure 60° and 62°. Find the exterior angle at the third vertex.
In a parallelogram, one angle measures 116°. Find the opposite angle.
In a triangle, a segment joins the midpoints of two sides. The third side measures 36. Find the length of the midsegment and state its relationship to the third side.
choices: 72, and it is parallel to the third side
18, and it is perpendicular to the third side
18, and it is parallel to the third side
36, and it is parallel to the third side
